nodes.label: ggplot
nodes.desc: The grammar-of-graphics object: data, mapping, layers, scales, facet, theme; the + operator accumulates components and draw() renders.

nodes.label: layer / Layers
nodes.desc: Each layer binds data to aesthetics, a stat and a geom; Layers(list) drives the whole build sequence.

nodes.label: stat
nodes.desc: Base class for 27 statistics; compute_layer partitions data by PANEL and group, then merges results back.

nodes.label: position
nodes.desc: Position adjustments (stack, dodge, jitter, nudge) with collision resolution in collide()/collide2().

nodes.label: geom
nodes.desc: Base class for 47 geometries; draw_layer fans out to panels and groups and emits matplotlib artists.

nodes.label: facet
nodes.desc: Base facet computes the panel layout, trains per-panel position scales and makes strip labels.

nodes.label: Layout
nodes.desc: Panel dataframe: setup(), train_position(), map_position(), reset_position_scales() so facets own the axis ranges.

nodes.label: scale / Scales
nodes.desc: Scales(list[scale]) transform, train and map every aesthetic; add_missing() guarantees x and y scales exist.

nodes.label: coord
nodes.desc: Coordinate systems (cartesian, fixed, flip, trans, radial) resolve panel ranges and munch data onto the panel.

nodes.label: theme
nodes.desc: Themeable properties; apply() pushes values into matplotlib artists and rcParams, theme_set() sets the global default.

nodes.label: p9Figure
nodes.desc: Figure subclass that stamps plotnine-created artists so re-draws stay under plotnine control.

nodes.label: PlotnineLayoutEngine
nodes.desc: A matplotlib LayoutEngine whose execute() arranges panels, strips, labels and legends from plotnine's own side spaces.
